a.xlink:title: Initializes the IMUs, barometers, GPS, servos and magnetometer.
Initializes sensor A, plus B and C if TMR_Toggle.
Initializes BMI323 A, plus B and C if tmr_on.
Checks WHO_AM_I, resets the chip, and starts 100 Hz continuous mode.
Releases the module from reset, checks it answers, and sends the config.
Starts PWM, centres both servos, records the zero reference, and checks they hold position.
Initializes the chip and starts continuous measurement.
Bosch delay callback: busy-waits on the DWT cycle counter.
Bosch read callback: reads len bytes starting at register reg_addr.
Bosch write callback: writes len bytes starting at register reg_addr.
Selects the chip-select pin, initializes the chip, and applies the flight config.
Bosch delay callback: busy-waits on the DWT cycle counter.
Bosch read callback: reads len bytes starting at register reg.
Bosch write callback: writes len bytes starting at register reg.
Writes both PWM compare registers for input plus the configured offsets (deg).
Converts readRawVoltage() to degrees relative to _zeroVoltage (360° per 3.3 V).
Reads both feedback voltages from ADC3 and smooths them.
